# ShareChess sound effects

Move by Move uses a curated set of recordings from the [ShareChess repository](https://github.com/sharechess/sharechess), copied from its public/sfx and public/sfx/anarchy directories.

All recordings included here are listed as **CC0 1.0** in the upstream [CREDITS.md](https://github.com/sharechess/sharechess/blob/main/public/CREDITS.md). The upstream credits also include recordings under CC BY and CC BY-NC terms; those files are intentionally not redistributed here.

| Local file | Application event | Creator | License and source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| move.mp3 | Standard move | mh2o | [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/) · [Freesound](https://freesound.org/people/mh2o/sounds/351518/) |
| cone-move.mp3 | Alternate recording | egomassive | [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/) · [Freesound](https://freesound.org/people/egomassive/sounds/536802/) |
| brick-take.mp3 | Capture | dichardson | [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/) · [Freesound](https://freesound.org/people/dichardson/sounds/570964/) |
| hit.mp3 | Check and invalid move | SypherZent | [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/) · [Freesound](https://freesound.org/people/SypherZent/sounds/420673/) |
| brick-castle.mp3 | Castling | SieuAmThanh | [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/) · [Freesound](https://freesound.org/people/SieuAmThanh/sounds/530812/) |
| snap.mp3 | Promotion and interface confirmation | alegemaate | [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/) · [Freesound](https://freesound.org/people/alegemaate/sounds/364699/) |
| checkmate.mp3 | Checkmate and wins (including resignation or timeout) | stumpbutt | [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/) · [Freesound](https://freesound.org/people/stumpbutt/sounds/381688/) |
| en-passant.mp3 | En passant capture | zar.265 | [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/) · [Freesound](https://freesound.org/people/zar.265/sounds/581334/) |

The active recordings were gain-matched at roughly −23.5 dBFS (RMS across the loudest 40 ms windows), with peak headroom. The en-passant clip was also shortened to 350 ms and faded. Playback uses the same volume slider for all recordings.
